evals.name: evidence-based-upgrade
evals.prompt: Update older Go code that uses math.Min/Max on ints, interface{} assertions, and manual error slicing.
evals.expected_output: Modern Go idioms using built-in min/max, any alias, and errors.Join.
assertions: Replaces math.Min/Max int conversions with built-in min/max.
Replaces interface{} with any where appropriate.
Uses errors.Join for combining multiple errors.

evals.name: replace-deprecated-libraries
evals.prompt: Modernize Go code that still imports io/ioutil for ReadAll and TempFile.
evals.expected_output: Replacement with io.ReadAll, os.ReadFile, and os.CreateTemp.
assertions: Uses io.ReadAll or os.ReadFile as drop-in modern replacements.

evals.name: verify-upgrade-compatibility
evals.prompt: After bumping go directive in go.mod to 1.24, verify the codebase for breaking changes and deprecations.
evals.expected_output: Verification workflow running go mod tidy, go test ./..., and golangci-lint.
assertions: Runs go mod tidy to update dependency checksums.
Runs complete test suite with race detector.
Verifies build constraints and compiler compatibility flags.
